questions.question: A and B take a contract to do a work for Rs. 4500. A alone can do a piece of work in 8 days and B alone can do a piece of work in 12 days. With the help of C they finish the work in 4 days, then find the share of C in the total amount.
questions.questionHtml: A and B take a contract to do a work for Rs. 4500. A alone can do a piece of work in 8 days and B alone can do a piece of work in 12 days. With the help of C they finish the work in 4 days, then find the share of C in the total amount.
questions.solution:
Given:

Total amount given for the work = Rs. 4500

A and B alone do the work in 8 and 12 days respectively.

With the help of C they finish the work in 4 days

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken 

The wage amount is always distributed among the workers according to the ratio of their workdone. 

Calculation:

LCM (8, 12) = 24

Let the total work be LCM of the time taken by individual workers. 

Hence, total work = 24 units

Efficiencies,

A does each day = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 units

B does each day = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 units

If the work is finished in 4 days, the team does each day = 24 ÷ 4 =  6 units

Hence, efficiency (each day) of C = 6 - (3 + 2) = 1 unit

Thus, ratio of the work done by A, B and C respectively = 3 : 2 : 1

Hence, C received = \(4500 \times {1 \over {3\ +\ 2\ +\ 1}}\) = Rs. 750.

∴ C's share of the total amount is Rs. 750.

questions.question: A, B and C can do a work in 8, 10 and 12 days, respectively. After completing the work together, they received Rs. 5,550. What is the share of B (in Rs.) in the amount received?
questions.questionHtml: A, B and C can do a work in 8, 10 and 12 days, respectively. After completing the work together, they received Rs. 5,550. What is the share of B (in Rs.) in the amount received?
questions.solution:
The ratio = 8: 10 : 12

The efficiency ratio of A, B, and C = 1/8 : 1/10 : 1/12

= 15 : 12 : 10  (Efficiency or wages ratio ∝ 1/Time taken)

So, their wages ratio = 15 : 12 : 10

The share of B = (12/37) × 5550 = Rs. 1800

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 8 days, 12 days and 16 days respectively. If the total amount paid for the piece of work is Rs. 2600. Find the difference in the wages earned by A and B.
questions.questionHtml: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 8 days, 12 days and 16 days respectively. If the total amount paid for the piece of work is Rs. 2600. Find the difference in the wages earned by A and B.
questions.solution:
Since the amount paid depends on efficiency,

Therefore, the ratio in which the profit earned is 6 : 4 : 3.

The total amount paid for the piece of work = Rs. 2600

The amount earned by A = \(\frac{6k}{6k+4k+3k}\) × Rs. 2600 = Rs. 1200

The amount earned by B = \(\frac{4k}{6k+4k+3k}\) × Rs. 2600 = Rs. 800

The difference in the amount earned = Rs. 1200 - Rs. 800 = Rs. 400

questions.question: Rohit can do a work in 13 days. With the help of Virat, the same work is finished in 6 days. If they get Rs. 1976 for that work. What is Virat's share. (In Rs.)
questions.questionHtml: Rohit can do a work in 13 days. With the help of Virat, the same work is finished in 6 days. If they get Rs. 1976 for that work. What is Virat's share. (In Rs.)
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

Time taken by Rohit = 13 days

Time taken by Rohit + Virat = 6 days

Total wages = RS 1976

CONCEPT:

Wages are distributed in the same ratio as efficiency (work done).

CALCULATION:

Let Total work = 78 units (L.C.M of 13, 6)

Rohit efficiency = 78/13 = 6 units

(Rohit + Virat) efficiency = 78/6 = 13 units

Virat's efficiency = 13 - 6 = 7 units

Rohit and Virat get money = 1976/13 = 152

Virat's share = 152 × 7 = Rs. 1064

Hence, "option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Ahmed and Abbas can do a work alone in 10 and 15 days, respectively. They work together for 5 days and leave, after which Akhtar finishes the work in 5 more days. If the total wages for the work are Rs. 6,000, then, respectively, the daily wages of Ahmed, Abbas and Akhtar are:
questions.questionHtml: Ahmed and Abbas can do a work alone in 10 and 15 days, respectively. They work together for 5 days and leave, after which Akhtar finishes the work in 5 more days. If the total wages for the work are Rs. 6,000, then, respectively, the daily wages of Ahmed, Abbas and Akhtar are:
questions.solution:
Ahmed and Abbas can do work alone in 10 and 15 days

LCM(10,15) = Total work i.e 30

The efficiency of Ahmed and Abbas is 30/10= 3, 30/15 = 2 

Ahmed and Abbas work together for 5 days and leave,

5 × (Efficiency of Ahmed + Efficiency of Abbas ) = 5 × 5 = 25

Remaining work = 30 - 25 = 5 

Akhtar finishes the remaining work in 5 days

The ratio of the Efficiencies of Ahmed, Abbas, and Akhtar = 3: 2: 1

Total wages = 3a + 2a + a = 6a , 6a = 6000, a = 1000

Daily wages of Ahmed, Abbas, and Aktar are 3a/5, 2a/5, and a/5 i.e 600Rs, 400Rs and 200Rs

questions.question: A, B and C can do a work in 4, 6 and 10 days respectively. They finish the work together and earn Rs. 310. What is the share of each?
questions.questionHtml: A, B and C can do a work in 4, 6 and 10 days respectively. They finish the work together and earn Rs. 310. What is the share of each?
questions.solution:
Given:

A can do a work in 4 days.

B can do a work in 6 days.

C can do a work in 10 days.

They are paid an amount of Rs. 310.

Formula used:

Total work = efficiency × total time

Amount distribution, X's amount = \(\dfrac{X's \ part}{total \ part}\) × total amount

Calculations:

Total work = LCM of the number of days they are working.

LCM of 4, 6, 10:

Factors of 4 = 2 × 2

Factors of 6 = 2 × 3

Factors of 10 = 2 × 5

So, the LCM = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 = 60

Now, part of work done by A = \(\dfrac{60}{4}\) = 15 units

Part of work done by B = \(\dfrac{60}{6}\) = 10 units

Part of work done by C = \(\dfrac{60}{10}\) = 6 units

Total units of work = 15 + 10 + 6 = 31 units

Now, amount of A = \(\dfrac{15}{31}\) × 310

= 15 × 10

= Rs. 150

Amount of B = \(\dfrac{10}{31}\) × 310

= 10 × 10

= Rs. 100

Amount of C = \(\dfrac{6}{31}\) × 310

= 6 × 10

= Rs. 60

∴ The answer is Rs. 150, Rs. 100, Rs. 60.

questions.question: A alone can complete a piece of work in 18 days and B alone can complete the same work in 24 days. A and B undertook the work for ₹22,500. They took the help of C and completed the work in 8 days. How much is to be paid to A?
questions.questionHtml: A alone can complete a piece of work in 18 days and B alone can complete the same work in 24 days. A and B undertook the work for ₹22,500. They took the help of C and completed the work in 8 days. How much is to be paid to A?
questions.solution:
Given:

Time is taken by A to complete the work = 18 days

Time is taken by A to complete the work = 24 days

Calculation:

Time taken by A to complete the work = 18 days

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 1/18 units 

Time taken by B to complete the work = 24 days

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = 1/24 units 

They complete the work in 8 days with the help of C

⇒ Work done by C in 1 day = 1/8 - (1/18 + 1/24) = 2/72 units

Ratio of work = A : B : C = (1/18) : (1/24) : 2/72 = 4 : 3 : 2

A's share = (4/9) × 22500

⇒ A = Rs.10,000

∴ Rs. 10,000 is to be paid to A.

Alternate Method

  Time Total Work Efficiency
A 18   4
B 24 72 3
A + B + C 8   9
⇒ 9 = 22500 × 4 = 10,000 = A

∴ Rs. 10,000 is to be paid to A.

questions.question: In a project, 6 persons are employed for a week and their working hours are 8 hours a day from which they earn Rs. 8400. If in the same project 9 persons are employed and their working hour is 6 hours a day and they work for a week, then find the amount they earned.
questions.questionHtml: In a project, 6 persons are employed for a week and their working hours are 8 hours a day from which they earn Rs. 8400. If in the same project 9 persons are employed and their working hour is 6 hours a day and they work for a week, then find the amount they earned.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Apply the Chain Rule formula: (M1 × D1 × H1) / W1 = (M2 × D2 × H2) / W2

Since the time period (1 week) is the same, ignore days: (6 × 8) / 8400 = (9 × 6) / W2

W2 = (8400 × 9 × 6) / (6 × 8) = 1050 × 9 = 9450

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 9450.

Alternate Method

Given:

M1 = 6, H1 = 8, W1 = Rs. 8400

M2 = 9, H2 = 6, W2 = ?

Formula Used:

Total Earning = (Number of Persons × Hours per Day × Total Days) × Rate per Hour

Calculations:

⇒ Total man-hours in Case 1 = 6 × 8 × 7 = 336 hours

⇒ Earning per man-hour = 8400 ÷ 336 = Rs. 25

⇒ Total man-hours in Case 2 = 9 × 6 × 7 = 378 hours

⇒ Total earning in Case 2 = 378 × 25

⇒ Total earning = Rs. 9450

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 9450.

Additional Information

Chain Rule Concept

The general formula for work and wages is (M1D1H1E1)/W1 = (M2D2H2E2)/W2, where M is persons, D is days, H is hours, E is efficiency, and W is work or wages.

Direct and Inverse Proportion

Earnings are directly proportional to the number of persons and hours. More people or more hours result in higher total earnings.

questions.question: P, Q, R together complete a work of Rs. 5000 per day. P and R together completed (18/25) of the work and P and Q together completed (20/25) of the work. Amount paid to R is:
questions.questionHtml: P, Q, R together complete a work of Rs. 5000 per day. P and R together completed (18/25) of the work and P and Q together completed (20/25) of the work. Amount paid to R is:
questions.solution:
Given,

⇒ Work done by P and R = 18/25

⇒ Work done by P and Q = 20/25

⇒ Work done by R = 1 – (20/25) = 5/25 = 1/5

Now,

⇒ Ratio of work done by R and (P and Q) = (1/5) ∶ (20/25) = 1/4

⇒ R's share = 5000 × {1/(1 + 4)} = 5000 × (1/5) = Rs. 1000

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 20 days while B can do it in 30 days. They work together for 10 days and the rest of the work is done by C in 5 days. If they get Rs 560 for the whole work, how much money will A get?
questions.questionHtml: A can do a piece of work in 20 days while B can do it in 30 days. They work together for 10 days and the rest of the work is done by C in 5 days. If they get Rs 560 for the whole work, how much money will A get?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Work done by A in 1 day is = 1/20

Work done by B in 1 day is = 1/30

Work done by A and B together in 1 day is = (1/20 + 1/30) = 1/12

Work is done by A and B together in 10 days is = 10/12

Remaining work = 1 – 10/12 = 2/12 = 1/6

C do 1/6 of the work in 5 days

Total work done by C alone in 5 × 6 is = 30 days

Wages ratio of A, B and C = 1/20 × 10 : 1/30 × 10 : 1/30 × 5 = 6 : 4 : 2

Money A will get = 6/12 × 560 = 280

∴ Share of money A will get is Rs 280
